limitations.issue: Family A identity, license, labels and prefix meanings are unverified.
SDT lying is mapped to HUMAN_FALL only as derived post-fall lying-posture evidence; it never proves a temporal fall event by itself.
SDT official CC-BY-4.0 metadata conflicts with non-commercial-research-only record text; this selection applies the stricter non-commercial research, citation and attribution conditions.

SDT has no subject/session/event IDs. T-A1 must preserve the official synthetic train / synthetic validation / real test split exactly; subject-wise and event-level generalization remain not verifiable.
Legacy NPZ retains only X/y and mixes official splits and heuristic labels.
SDT train and validation payloads are dataless multi-GB placeholders.
MUVIM and Thermal Fall 66 require external access and terms review.
eHomeSeniors lacks documented normal/ADL sequences and explicit repeated-fall boundaries.
Thermal-44 units, dtype, endianness, conversion, invalid pixels, packet size and real driver remain unverified.
